notes.title: Bugfix, adding link to discord community to the main menu
notes.notes:
Greetings, detectives and students! 

Thanks to everyone who has already played or is about to play. Don't forget that you can report any bugs in the game in the corresponding topic in the game community hub, there you can also create topics to find out your questions. Maybe it will be more convenient for some people to do use discord - that's why I made game community server for you with compact link in the main menu. I will try to answer your questions and fix any bugs as soon as possible.
Enjoy the game and the adventure!

Sincerely,
Faithy

notes.title: Minor bug fixes
notes.notes: Small updates will be released regularly as we discover various bugs. So thanks to everyone for reporting on them!

notes.title: The long-awaited release of Sunlight Scream on Steam
notes.notes:
The long-suffering visual novel finally got life on Steam. Get up, student! Study, girls, adventures, and most importantly - a killer in a mask! It's time to work as a detective and find out who is hiding under the mask, without getting under the knife. And preferably save your friends. At least once in a while. 

This is my first game, created entirely on my own and on pure enthusiasm. I put a lot of effort and persistence to make it, and I'm extremely happy that it finally appears on my favorite store - Steam. Looking at the current trend of prices in the store I decided to go against the mainstream - I lowered the price of the game by three times of the planned price. Feel free to add the game to your wishlist, buy it, create content!

And the most important thing at the moment is the release date. Due to Steam restrictions I will be able to release the game not earlier than [b]October 2, so be it.[/b]. 

In the meantime, here's some ice cream from Erika!
